name: Refraction
description: The frame is seen through flowing liquid glass that bends the first clip more and more, with rainbow fringes, flares up as the second clip takes over, then calms down and clears. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: strength
params.description: How far the glass bends the picture at the peak

params.name: scale
params.description: Size of the flowing waves: higher makes smaller waves

params.name: brightness
params.description: Brightness of the flare at the peak
